name: NoMoreFlat
summary: A game-specific mod that adds Sequential-View Rendering (Alternate Eye Rendering) to games that don't support stereo natively. Rather than rendering two full views simultaneously (Dual-View), it alternates rendering the left and right eye on successive frames. Works on games with accessible rendering pipelines. Primary use case has been Assassin's Creed Odyssey and similar Anvil Engine titles.
compatibility_notes: Sequential-View Rendering means each eye only receives half the total frames — visual stability requires a consistent, high framerate to avoid eye-flips. Game-specific. Requires consistent framerate to avoid per-eye stutter. Not a general-purpose injector.
